schema_review.rationale: Revision v1_5_0_006 follows v1_5_0_005 on both registered source chains and all vector/Code profiles. It adds one NOT NULL column with a server default, pc_scopes.lifecycle_state, values ('writable','archived','deleting','deleted'), so every existing Scope reads back 'writable' without a data rewrite or a retroactive state change. Scope tree, parent edges, context references, external references, creation requests, settings and bindings are unchanged; this revision adds no table, index, foreign key or check constraint, and it rewrites no existing row. Artifact, Source, Candidate, processing and publication storage are untouched, so an upgraded database keeps every identity, revision, digest and evidence row it already had, and revision v1_5_0_005 keeps its original schema fingerprint. Backward: an older binary rejects the newer schema before serving it. Forward: the upgrade is additive DDL only and needs no domain step or backfill, so repeated apply and verify remain no-op after the first successful run. Archive and deletion lifecycle enforcement is runtime behavior over this state, not a further persisted encoding change.
